6k-Mile 2003 Dodge Ram 1500 ST at No Reserve
results.description: This 2003 Dodge Ram 1500 ST is a regular cab pickup that remained registered to the original owner in Texas through 2026 and now has just 6k miles. Finished in Bright White over Dark Slate Gray cloth, the truck is powered by a 5.7-liter Hemi V8 that drives the rear wheels through a five-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes chrome-styled 17" five-spoke steel wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, air conditioning, cruise control, and a CD stereo. This Ram 1500 is offered by the selling dealer at no reserve with a window sticker, manufacturer's literature, an accident-free Carfax report, and a clean Texas title.
